notes.title: 💼 Attention, Agents: Operation Autumn Sale Is a Go! 💼
notes.content:
The mission begins on November 27—and your objective is clear: secure Stealth Assault: Urban Strike at an unbeatable discount during the Steam Autumn Sale! 🍂🎮

🎯 Your tools of the trade:
- High-octane stealth missions in dynamic urban settings.
- Gadgets and strategies to outsmart your enemies.
- Thrills, danger, and adrenaline at every turn!

💣 Mission briefing: Be prepared to strike swiftly, because this deal won’t last forever. The shadows await your mastery.
🕶️ Gear up and claim your discount—November 27 is just around the corner!
